title: Director - AI Adoption & Workforce Transformation
sourceText: Make an impact with NTT DATAJoin a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.Your day at NTT DATAThe Director, Consulting is a leadership role, responsible for collaborating with senior business stakeholders to formulate and implement the consulting services strategy and organizational capability that provides vision and forward direction for the business.This role takes responsibility for defining and managing a sustainable and profitable consulting practice aligned to the strategy of the overall business and, provides guidance and advice on leveraging service management capabilities to effectively deliver value to clients.This role aims to increase business value with key clients and to realize pull-through business as a result of consultancy engagements.This leadership role is responsible for fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture across the consulting team(s) within their remit.Key responsibilities:Gains support from other business areas and stakeholders to execute strategic plans that align to overall consulting services strategic goals and ensures the implementation thereof.Oversees day to day activities of a team of consulting professionals in the functional area.Provides direction to consulting team(s) in complex engagements by generating demand through acting as a subject matter expert.Develops the required process, policies and tools relating to financial, people, marketing and delivery management and ensures they are in place and managed operationally.Leverages their relationship skills and knowledge of the client environment to assist and influence the client.Takes full ownership for managing efficiency levels, streamlining and continuously improving procedures to deliver customer excellence.Oversees the delivery of client requirements against agreed contracts for relevant consulting areas.Collaborates with senior leadership to develop strategy and manages implementation to achieve revenue and expense targets.Ensures that the business unit meet its profitability targets, maximizing revenue per billable resource within agreed cost constraints and without compromising the integrity and standards of the company.Participates with senior managers to formulate and implement the Consulting Services strategy and organizational capability that provides vision and forward direction for the business.Sets the standard for client satisfaction and develops client service policies, procedures and standards that will drive optimization and client satisfaction.Uses understanding of business objectives, market trends and client requirements to develop a consulting service practice and that is aligned to the business strategy and goals and builds a seamless service operation.To thrive in this role, you need to have:Deep knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.Robust understanding of the vast range of IT operations and organizational service offeringsDemonstrates strong levels of client engagement.Service orientated with the ability to manage client value whilst maintaining profitable business results.Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of the product’s functionality and capability and how it is applied to solve client’s problems.Motivational and inspirational leader with superior decision-making skills and assertiveness.Excellent collaboration skills and able to interact professionally at all levels internally and externally.Problem solver with solid strategic thinking capability and good analytical skillsStrong conceptual thinking ability.Ability to manage urgent and complex tasks simultaneously.A strong market orientation with experience working with clients and business teams to create client-orientated solutions and services.Academic qualifications and certifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology and/or Business Management or a related field.Scaled Agile certification desirable.Relevant consulting and technical certifications preferred.Required experience:Significant level of relevant experience in similar role within a related environment.Significant previous experience operationally managing and leading a consulting team.Significant experience dealing with clients and managing service levels.Significant stakeholder engagement experience at all levels in the organization.Significant project management experience.Workplace type: On-site WorkingAbout NTT DATANTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the
